tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Zuro's display: every panel, HUD bar, bubble, toast, map and building sheet. The one surface for UI.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Raised area inside a night panel (quote, lore message).

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: 3px outline of night panels and round buttons; separates the display from the sand.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Main text and numbers on night (13.9:1).

tokens.name: amber-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text and small caps labels on night (6.1:1). In CSS written as rgba(255,226,184,.62).

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Water amounts and the water bar on night (11.6:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold scrap amounts on night (12.2:1).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Warnings on night: low water, missing materials, losses (8.3:1).

tokens.name: act
tokens.usage: Current expedition action button (Dismantle, Build camp). Text on it is ink (8.2:1). FAILS on sand: 1.1:1 against the ground.

tokens.name: terra
tokens.usage: Brand accent: roofs, logo edge, current primary button. FAILS as a button on sand: 2.2:1 against the ground, white text on it 3.7:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Dark text on light grounds: building labels, text on act, text on paper (11.1:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Old light label pills in the world (building names, hero name). Left over from before the night style.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Ground base colour of the village, before light.

tokens.name: sand-lit
tokens.usage: The ground as it renders in daylight (measured from a screenshot). Every control drawn over the world is judged against this.

tokens.name: oasis
tokens.usage: Oasis grass and palms; never used for UI.

tokens.name: sea-shallow
tokens.usage: Shallow water along the coast.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Deep sea.

tokens.name: biome-dunes
tokens.usage: Ground tint: Dunes (south).

tokens.name: biome-salt
tokens.usage: Ground tint: Salt Flats (north).

tokens.name: biome-redrock
tokens.usage: Ground tint: Red Rocks (east).

tokens.name: biome-oldtown
tokens.usage: Ground tint: Old Town (west).

tokens.name: proposal-water-deep
tokens.usage: PROPOSAL B: deep water teal for the primary 'water' action. 3.2:1 against sand, amber text on it 4.6:1.

tokens.name: proposal-terra-deep
tokens.usage: PROPOSAL C: deeper terracotta for the primary button. 3.7:1 against sand, light text 6.3:1.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: ZURODA wordmark, all caps, amber with warm glow.

styles.name: hud-value
styles.usage: Numbers in the top bar (water, scrap, gold, energy). Tabular figures.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label; the main button uses 17px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second line inside a button ('2.0 L from the well').

styles.name: world-label
styles.usage: Building names floating in the village (paper pill, ink text).

styles.name: walked
styles.usage: Tiny '12 480 m walked' line under the top bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between HUD items; screen edge for small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (sides), button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, chips, info boxes inside panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Bubbles and toasts (bubble has one 4px corner toward Zuro).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Zuro's display panels: top bar, sheets, map, summary.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All buttons; round buttons are circles.
